column2: My blood's pumpin'!
Brawl in the stands, let's goooo!
Quit starin' at me!
Get 'em! Knock 'em flat!
I love fightin' more than three square meals!
Don't you underestimate me!
You mockin' me, you punk!?
Hey, quit stepping on my foot!
Don't look at me with those pervy eyes!
I can't hold back no more!
My fighting spirit's burning bright!
MAN! MAN!
Oh, Papa!
Your father?
Daemon Abashiri, head of the Abashiri Family! My papa!
The Abashiri Family!?
Mister, how d'ya like the Chizakura Gang's chances?
Heh! They'll croak in no time!
What!
My precious kids are in the Chizakura Gang! Watch your mouth!
Well, surprised? Papa can use psychic powers!
Kikunosuke! Papa's cheering for you! Oh? You the Chizakura Gang's ringer? Look after Nao and Kiku for me!
Y-yes, sir. I'm {p}. I'll do my best...
And this is my big brother Goemon and my little brother Kichiza!
Kiku-chan, I'm cheering for you too, sweetie!
Lose and you'll be sorry!
Kikunosuke! Papa's cheering for you!
...What the! Whoaaaaaa!!
Ready?
Block B finals tournament, round one! Fighters, enter the ring! A one-fall match, no rules!\n\nDon't think you're gettin' out alive! Let the brawl begin!!

Block B finals tournament, round two! Fighters, enter the ring! A one-fall match, no rules!

Both teams, fight to the death!

Brawl, START!!

Block B final! Fighters, enter the ring! A one-fall match, no rules!\n\nIf you're lucky enough to live, next up is the real final showdown! This is a bloodbath to celebrate in advance, so get it started!!
Brawl Festival final! Fighters, enter the ring! A one-fall match, no rules! A deathmatch of terror to decide the champion! Send 'em to Hell! Brawl, BEGIN!!
The tournament final needs a bit more time to set up. Come back later.
Block B's matches haven't started yet. Come back later.
The guest team from Gongane Academy is so strong! Especially that little boy!
He's dressed all grubby, but he's sooo strong! I bet he wins the Block A final!

I am General Hisan! War wounded me and left me looking like a monster.\n\nRevenge! I'll punish every last human who starts wars! How deep my wounds are! How much I lost! I'll make the whole world feel it!
Nice work! Next up is the tournament final!
Here we go!
They say the Block A final was a forfeit win. Seems the fighters disappeared.
Did they run away?
So our opponents never fought their block final, right? That puts us at a disadvantage...!
There's still time before the tournament final. Rest up while you can!
What happened to that Gongane Academy kid with the hunting cap and coat?
They say he wandered off somewhere.
Kill the Iyahaya brat in the chaos of the Brawl Festival! That was your plan, wasn't it?
Yes, sir!
So what do you mean he's GONE!? Whaaa!?
My deepest apologies!
Jeez Louise!\n\nBig sister's gonna yell at me again!
The Block A winner is the Gokuraku Gang!\n\nA guest team from St. Paradise Middle School!
They say the Gokuraku Gang's leader is the principal of St. Paradise Middle School.
Kikunosuke, here's a yummy lunch Papa made!
The tempura looks so good! Have some too, {p}!
Yum, yum!
Nummy, nummy!
Pop, you hear?\n\nOur opponent in the final is Paradise Middle's principal, Danjuro Namakubi!
What!? HIM!?
Danjuro Namakubi?
Paradise Middle... The principal of St. Paradise Middle School. Paradise Middle is a school that trains assassins.
Heh heh heh... Namakubi, eh? Interesting. Hearin' that, I can't just sit still. Boys, we're jumpin' in too. We're helpin' Kikunosuke!
You got it!
Heh heh... I'm rarin' to go!
Leave it to us!
The Abashiri Family is crashin' the Brawl Festival!
No fair! Isn't it against the rules for a principal to fight?
I have spent 80 years of my life on murder... No one I targeted ever survived.
Except our old man, right?
But I am not the man I was! I entered this Brawl Festival to test that!
All right, we won!
All riiight! Victory salute!
Run, {p}!\n\nKichiza's clothes are made of a special fiber made from explosives!
You mean... his clothes ARE dynamite!?
Hyaaah!
Whoaaa!
Phew... Looks like things finally calmed down.
We won thanks to you guys. Thanks a bunch!
If it weren't for {p}, we couldn't even have entered!
I'm glad a transfer student like {p} showed up!
I told you, I'm not a transfer student! Actually...
{p}! The Abashiri Family's gonna back you up! Gotta repay ya for winnin' the Brawl Festival!
Yeah, yeah! Besides, it sounds like fun!
Ah, you idiot! Stop it, Kichiza!
Too late!
Oh yeah! This thing fell from the gym ceiling a minute ago. A key to somewhere, maybe? Here, you take it!
Those who fear no sin have joined...\n\nAnd those who cross between worlds join next...
We're locked in!?
...Don't let your guard down, {p}!
Pipe dooown!
Hmm! You're a Demon, aren't ya!?
A Demon? I ain't nothin' like that! I'm a kappa!
A kappa? Don't give me that crap!
H-hey now, mister...!\n\nE-Enma-kuuun!
Kapaeru, what're you making a racket about?
Hmm!? You guys are possessed by a yokai, aren't ya? Especially you!
There's something fishy about you!
This oughta be fun...
H-hold on a second!
I'm {p}! Who exactly are you?
